# Marlai Fine Thai Cuisine

> > Marlai Fine Thai Cuisine is a family-owned Thai restaurant in Seattle's University District serving authentic Thai dishes with Pacific Northwest ingredients.

Owned and operated by Marlai and Udom Inc., this Seattle establishment offers lunch and dinner menus featuring traditional Thai appetizers, soups, salads, and seafood dishes including local Dungeness crab. The restaurant provides dine-in, takeout, catering services, and online ordering for the University District community.
